notes.title: Updates for 10/14/2024
notes.content: Update answers to be represented as buttons.  Planning a port to mobile soon and buttons were needed for UI updates.

notes.title: 📢 Bible Verse Challenge - Exciting New Update! 🎉
notes.content:
📢 Bible Verse Challenge - Exciting New Update! 🎉

Dear Bible Verse Challenge players,
We’re thrilled to announce a major update to improve your gameplay experience! Check out the latest changes that are now live in the game:

✨ 4 New Achievements Added!
Added scoring achievements for 25, 50, 500, and 5000!  The scoring update also removed the 10000 scoring achievement.

🕒 Removal of Elapsed Time
Time tracking has been removed from the challenge mode. Take your time to find the right answer, no more rush!

📊 Steam Leaderboard Integration
We’ve added Steam Leaderboards! Now you can track scores, compete with other players, and see the Top 10 leaderboard updated with profiles.

❤️ Revamped Heart & Scoring System
Lost a heart? No problem! You can now recover a heart after answering a question correctly.

✔️ Show Correct Answers
After each question, we’ll now show you the correct answer so you can learn as you go and continue whenever you're ready!

🎵 New Music Options
We’ve expanded the soundtrack! Now, you can choose from 5 different songs, or shuffle them for variety.

🔊 More Sound Effects
Enjoy a greater variety of sound effects for both correct and incorrect answers, giving the game a fresh feel!

📖 Two New Bible Versions
We’ve added the World English Bible (WEB) and Bible in Basic English (BBE)! To make it easier, the name of each version will be displayed for clarity.

notes.title: Updates in Progress - Bible Verse Challenge
notes.content:
We are working on some updates for the Bible Verse Challenge that are listed below:

[list]
[*]Remove Elapsed Time. 
[list]
[*]Time tracking is being removed from the challenge.  Take your time and get the right answer!
[/list]
[*]Scored recorded only if higher than lowest score.
[list]
[*]New scores tied with the lowest will not be recorded, update after removing elapsed time
[/list]
[*]Implement Steam Leaderboard
[list]
[*]Wasn't even aware it existed!  Will be used to track scores and then show it on the game.  Will retain current Top 10 store with profile
[/list]
[*]Revamp Heart  and Scoring system
[list]
[*]It is hard to not miss 5 verses.  If you lose a heart, you will recover it after answering 3 questions correctly.
[/list]
[*]Show correct answer every time
[list]
[*]Removing the elapsed time allows us to show the correct answer and then let you continue when you're ready.
[/list]
[*]Add more music options
[list]
[*]Only one song is playing.  Will add at least add 3 more songs and allow you to choose or play all of them randomly.  
[/list]
[*]Add more sound effect options
[list]
[*]Allow more than the current sound effects to be played for incorrect and correct answers.
[/list]
[*]Add two more Bible versions
[list]
[*]Add WEB (World English Bible) and BBE (Bible in Basic English).  Need to add names to each version as well since users might not be familiar with them.
[/list]
[/list]
